_about: The one list the help is built from: the sidebar and its order, each page's title and summary, the search index, the sitemap and llms.txt. A page is site/help/<slug>.md; add it here and Tools/Site/build_site.py picks it up.

pages.title: Browse your machines
pages.summary: How the library is laid out on each device, how to search it, what a host's details and this device's host show, the Mac's link to its own machine in the library, and the overview of time in use and connections.

pages.title: Add a machine and its services
pages.summary: Add a host with a Terminal, Database or Desktop service, add more services, edit them, and remove services or hosts.

pages.title: Connect and switch between sessions
pages.summary: Use the Connect controls and the Mac's Command Palette, switch to or close open sessions from Active and the lightning button, see everything open with Show All Windows, shrink windows into orbs on Vision Pro, where they stand or together in a dock, put windows in the orb dock on a Mac, and put two sessions side by side on iPhone Duo, or one across both pages.

pages.title: Widgets
pages.summary: The Machines, Machine and Active widgets on iPhone, iPad, Vision Pro and Mac: where they go, what they show, and what choosing them does.

pages.title: Siri, Shortcuts and the rest of the system
pages.summary: Siri phrases and Shortcuts actions, sending files to a machine, Spotlight, Controls, Handoff, dragging a service into its own window, ssh:// links, and on the Mac the Finder's Services, toolbar button and Quick Action, Open With and the Dock menu.

pages.title: Favorites, collections and other names
pages.summary: Mark favorites, find recent hosts, group hosts into collections, and give a host other names that search and matching use.

pages.title: Manage SSH keys
pages.summary: Import keys or generate them in the Secure Enclave, see which services use a key, and copy, export, rename or delete keys.

pages.title: Your library on all your devices
pages.summary: What iCloud and iCloud Drive sync and what stays on one device, when syncing happens, what the sync status says and what to do, and how conflicts resolve.

pages.title: Settings and window appearance
pages.summary: Open Settings on each device, choose Light or Dark, set window opacity and glass, choose where orbs go on Vision Pro and where the orb dock floats on a Mac, and read the General, Privacy and About pages.

pages.title: Connect to a machine over SSH
pages.summary: Set up a Terminal service, connect, enter passwords, route through jump hosts, allow legacy algorithms, and recover from dropped connections.

pages.title: Sign in with keys and trust host keys
pages.summary: Sign in with an SSH or Secure Enclave key, install your public key, and trust or refuse a machine's host key.

pages.title: Work in a terminal
pages.summary: Terminal windows, tabs and splits, the plus menu and the sidebar on Mac and Vision Pro, moving tabs between windows, what comes back after a relaunch, a terminal that loses its connection, the tools menu, Focus Mode on Vision Pro and its rooms, text size, scaling the text with the window, suggestions as you type, search, paste review and pasting pictures and files, links and paths, previewing a printed path's file and following a log, opening SQL in the SQL editor, Mermaid diagrams, selecting on Vision Pro, dropping files, snippets, recording, the Mac's local shell, and the bar and tabs below the fold on iPhone Duo.

pages.title: Keep terminals running with tmux
pages.summary: Keep each terminal in its own tmux session with its whole history, reconnect to it, pick it up from Active on another device or add it to a window as a tab, end it, see what a relaunch brings back, open a basic terminal outside tmux, and keep the Mac's local terminals running in the background.

pages.title: Browse and transfer files over SFTP
pages.summary: Open the file browser, upload and download, create, rename, move and delete items, and edit remote files in the Editor.

pages.title: Forward ports through an SSH session
pages.summary: Add local, remote and SOCKS5 port forwards to a live SSH session, start and stop them, and fix common failures.

pages.title: Save and open terminal Workgroups
pages.summary: Create Workgroups of terminal tabs with startup commands, open them on each platform, open a Mac's terminals on that Mac from every other device, and swap in SSH where a device has no way to reach that Mac.

pages.title: Terminal settings, themes and snippets
pages.summary: The Connections, Terminal, Snippets and Suggestions settings pages, text size, resizing, previews and Focus Mode, choosing a theme, color schemes from Terminal profiles, theme editing, a terminal window's own settings and name, SSH config import and Tailscale.

pages.title: Backgrounds and glowing text
pages.summary: Give a terminal window a look: a picture, Coding Agent, Digital Rain, Synthwave, Aurora, Starfield, Blueprint or a phosphor screen behind the text, phosphor and Blueprint palettes and a glow, and Readability to keep the text clear.

pages.title: Add a database service
pages.summary: Add a MySQL, PostgreSQL or SQLite database to a host, fill in its fields, and make it read-only.

pages.title: Encryption and the SSH tunnel
pages.summary: Turn on TLS, choose how the certificate is verified, understand the unencrypted warning, and connect through the host's SSH service.

pages.title: The database workspace
pages.summary: Connect, browse databases and schemas, read the overview and charts, use schema commands and the Mutation Log, reconnect, set text sizes and scale the grid with the system's, and give a window its own settings.

pages.title: Browse table data
pages.summary: Switch table views, sort, filter and page rows, manage columns, analyze, follow foreign keys and export.

pages.title: See a database's diagram
pages.summary: Every table, column and foreign key as a live diagram, in three dimensions on Vision Pro.

pages.title: Edit rows and structure
pages.summary: Edit, add, delete and paste rows with a review before every write, and change columns, indexes and foreign keys.

pages.title: Write and run SQL
pages.summary: Run statements, use Explain Plan, write SQL on iPhone Duo half open, cancel and format, save .sql files, use query history with literal redaction, and keep saved queries.

pages.title: The on-device assistant
pages.summary: Generate SQL, get suggested fixes and automatic tab titles from the on-device model, and see exactly what it is given.

pages.title: Add a remote desktop
pages.summary: Add an RDP or VNC Desktop service to a host, what each field means, and how to edit or remove it.

pages.title: Import an RDP file
pages.summary: Turn a .rdp file into a host with a Desktop service, what the import keeps, and which files it refuses.

pages.title: Sign in and trust a remote computer
pages.summary: NLA and TLS fallback, VNC password or Mac account sign-in, verifying RDP certificates, and what is not supported.

pages.title: Connect to and leave a remote desktop
pages.summary: Open a desktop, enter a password when asked, read status and failures, reconnect, give a desktop window its own settings, and close a session.

pages.title: Remote desktops on Apple Vision Pro
pages.summary: The desktop window's controls and shape, headset input, glass opacity and strength, and removing the remote background.

pages.title: Resolution, scaling and zoom
pages.summary: Match Window Size, Detail, fixed resolutions, several displays and a window for each, a Mac's displays and pointer, Screen Sharing quality, Retina displays at 1x, a smaller picture from a Mac and what the network carries, High Performance from a Mac, keeping a window in its display's shape, and zooming the image in the window.

pages.title: Keyboard, pointer, clipboard and audio
pages.summary: Typing, the Keys menu and arrow pad, pointer modes and gestures, the keyboard, shortcuts and trackpad on iPhone Duo half open, sharing the clipboard, and remote audio.

pages.title: Open the Editor
pages.summary: Ways into the Editor on each platform, what an editor window holds, new documents, and how to leave or close it.

pages.title: Work with Projects
pages.summary: Open folders on this device or on a server as projects, manage the Projects list, and how it syncs between devices.

pages.title: Use Git in the Editor
pages.summary: Source Control: the file list's marks and Show Only Changed Files, stage files, hunks and lines, commit and amend, pull and push, the history and its graph, branches, stashes and tags, resolve conflicts, blame, and clone, on this Mac or on a server.

pages.title: Files, Folders and Tabs
pages.summary: Browse a project's files, preview and keep tabs, type on iPhone Duo half open, create new files locally or on a server, and open files on their own.

pages.title: Save Your Work
pages.summary: Save with ⌘S or the toolbar, choose where a new document goes, handle files that changed, and close unsaved documents.

pages.title: Languages, Find and the Status Bar
pages.summary: The 15 highlighted languages and their extensions, changing a file's language, the status bar, Go to Line, and Find and Replace.

pages.title: Preview and Viewers
pages.summary: Preview Markdown with Mermaid diagrams, HTML, SVG and CSV, view images, PDFs, video, audio and 3D models, and what happens with large files.

pages.title: Editor Settings
pages.summary: Text size, line numbers and wrapping at four levels: the Editor's defaults, a window, a project, and a single file; and a window's own glass.
